```lean
intro h
split
· intro hq
  use hq.1
  exact ⟨hq.2.1, hq.2.2⟩
· intro hq
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq1⟩ := hq
  have hq2 : |x| ≤ q • |y| := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    apply le_trans _ hq1
    apply mul_le_mul_left
    exact (hf.lt_iff_lt.1 hq0).mp (le_refl _)
  rw [ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt (ne_zero_of_gt hq0)]
  exact ⟨q, hq0, hq2⟩
```
